SongNodes and the music library

Data flow report: 7 Nov 2026

The estate serves one loop: radio plays and DJ tracklists come in, become a curated club library, feed set building and the graph of proven transitions, play out in TIDAL and Rekordbox, and should come back as play history and corrections. Today the loop is open at the last step.

Section 1: Executive summary

Read as: one estate of two projects. songnodes (git, main @7429821) is the source of truth for SongNodes; E:\musicLibrary (no git) is read from a snapshot taken 7 Nov 2026 without its 58 GB data folder. Queued = open PRs #576–#580, musicLibrary plan/jules_payloads and unmerged briefs.

What holds

  • songnodes is Git-first with one integration branch, a scope guard and design-system CI; the frontend copy of the design system is in sync and its checkers report zero findings.
  • The scraping core is one unified-scraper container with complete-playlist rules, idempotency keys on ingest jobs and FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED job claiming.
  • musicLibrary's weekly run is a clear eight-step file pipeline with an append-only ledger, a resumable resolve step and a full SQLite rebuild every run.
  • Both projects already share one design system, one TIDAL developer app and one saved-set idea, so the join points are few and nameable.

What strains

  • Contracts between the two projects have drifted: the documented sync script and file do not exist, and the two Set Builders no longer share a saved-set shape.
  • The medallion model in CLAUDE.md is not what runs: the scraper writes silver directly and no gold or operational job runs in compose.
  • Feedback loops are missing: play history, overrides and proven transitions never flow back into curation or set building, and no track has a BPM or key yet.
  • Security posture is not ready for the queued tunnel: write and admin routes are open and the queued login falls back to a default account.

Section 5: Synchronisation protocols, timings and limits

21 protocols

Protocol: Resumable resolve

Participants
ml-cli-resolve, ml-agent-weekly-run
How it syncs
Load inbox/resolved_<date>.json if present; todo = to_resolve items whose norm_key is not yet a key; 4 worker threads; results merged in order and the whole file re-dumped every 20 songs and at the end. The agent loops 'timeout 160 ... resolve' until the final line appears.
Conflicts
first result per norm_key wins; an empty result (both APIs failed or no match) is stored and never retried for that date
Stale data
no TIDAL app secret: Deezer only
State
Built
Evidence2
  • musicLibrary/pipeline/run_weekly.py:414-463
  • musicLibrary/agent/weekly_run.md:3

Protocol: Ledger save and snapshot

Participants
ml-cli-ingest, ml-cli-process, ml-cli-confirm
How it syncs
json.dump to <ledger>.tmp; process first copy2's the existing ledger to ledger/history/ledger_before_<date>.json; os.replace tmp over the ledger.
Conflicts
last writer wins; no lock or version check
Stale data
history snapshots for manual restore
State
Built
Evidence1
  • musicLibrary/pipeline/djlib/ledger.py:62-70

Protocol: TIDAL crate reconcile

Participants
ml-cli-sync-tidal, ext-tidal, ml-cli-confirm
How it syncs
Desired = every active crate's tidal ids sorted by energy then BPM; playlists in tidal_playlists.json without 'set:' prefix and no longer a crate are emptied. For each: create if missing (Idempotency-Key uuid5('create:'+name)), list items, remove extras, add missing in chunks of 50 (onDuplicates SKIP, key uuid5(add:pid:date:name:n:i)). Then writes sync_result and runs confirm.
Conflicts
ledger is the source of truth; TIDAL order is not enforced for crates
Stale data
no user token: step skipped; TidalError: ALERT_tidal.txt and partial results
State
Built
Evidence2
  • musicLibrary/pipeline/run_weekly.py:467-521
  • musicLibrary/pipeline/djlib/tidal.py:237-272

Protocol: Saved set to TIDAL

Participants
ml-store-artifact-db, ml-agent-weekly-run, ml-cli-sync-sets, ext-tidal
How it syncs
Weekly agent copies ArtifactData rows into inbox/artifact_sets.json; load_sets flattens {id,data}; sets with tidal truthy map track ids through the ledger (fallback tr.tidal_id); playlist key 'set:<id>'; if current item list != wanted ids, remove all then add all.
Conflicts
page copy wins (full replace)
Stale data
no token: skipped with message
State

Protocol: Artifact saved-set mirror

Participants
ml-page-set-builder, ml-store-artifact-db
How it syncs
initSavedSets: mem = localStorage; race use('db') and collection.get against 4 s; mem = remote + local-only; upload local-only. writeSavedSets: localStorage at once; changed docs set() and missing ids delete() on a serial promise queue with errors swallowed.
Conflicts
shared copy wins by id at load; local deletions made while the store was unreachable are never replayed
Stale data
no db: localStorage only
State
Built

Protocol: library.json to songnodes

Participants
ml-cli-sync-songnodes, sn-scripts, sn-be-library-ingest
How it syncs
POST body = file bytes, Idempotency-Key 'import-'+md5(file); enqueue library_ingest job; worker maps short keys, upserts tracks, writes library.track_xref(source_id -> canonical uuid), appearances, rotation_history, then queues projections and enrichment backfill. The songnodes script polls /api/v1/jobs/<id> and retries a dead job; run_weekly does not poll.
Conflicts
same file never imports twice; a changed file is a new job
Stale data
run_weekly prints a note on failure and carries on
State
Built

  • songnodes/scripts/import-music-library.sh:29-70
  • songnodes/services/library/ingest/handler.py:6-17

Protocol: TIDAL PKCE login through the songnodes app

Participants
ml-cli-tidal, ext-tidal, songnodes frontend :3006
How it syncs
login-start stores verifier/state in tidal_pkce_pending.json and prints the authorize URL with redirect 127.0.0.1:3006/oauth/callback; the user copies the landing address; login-finish checks state and age (15 min) and exchanges the code with client_secret in the body.
Conflicts
if songnodes is running, its /oauth/callback route (App.tsx) consumes the single-use code with its own verifier, so musicLibrary's exchange fails
Stale data
refresh_token on expiry; else re-login
State

Participants
ml-persona-curator, ml-cli-scrape
How it syncs
Rows without 'processed' are appended to the scrape rows, then the CSV is rewritten with processed=<run date> before raw_<date>.json is written.

none

Protocol: Durable job queue (ingestion_jobs)

Participants
sn-be-svc-rest-api, sn-be-svc-worker, sn-be-tbl-ingestion-jobs
How it syncs
enqueue INSERT ON CONFLICT (kind,idempotency_key) DO NOTHING returning the original row; claim_next first dead-letters expired leases with no attempts left, then selects queued (run_after<=now) or lease-expired running rows FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and increments attempts; handler and follow-up enqueues and complete run in one transaction; failure -> fail() requeues with backoff 30s*2^(attempts-1) capped 3600s (x4 for transient), dead when attempts>=max_attempts or permanent 4xx (except 408/429).
Conflicts
idempotency key returns existing job; SKIP LOCKED prevents double claim; lease reclaim for crashed workers
Stale data
dead jobs revived by POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/retry; succeeded pruned after 14 days
State
Built

Protocol: Recurring jobs via time-bucketed keys

Participants
sn-be-svc-worker
How it syncs
songnodes.schedule every 30s enqueues projection_consume, graph_projection_consume (15s buckets), ingest_pending (60s), scrape_targets (3600s), audio_analysis (600s) with key tick:{kind}:{now//interval}.
Conflicts
overlapping beats collide on the same key
Stale data
missed buckets are simply skipped

Protocol: Transactional outbox to projections

Participants
all catalog writers, projection_tracks consumer, graph_projection consumer
How it syncs
append in the writer transaction; consumers read (txid,id) > offset and txid < pg_snapshot_xmin; handler + advance in one transaction; 3 attempts then outbox_dead_letters and advance; rebase_after_restore resets txids after dump/restore.
Conflicts
keyed upserts, at-least-once
Stale data
projection_reconcile / rebuild jobs; POST /api/v1/projections/tracks/reconcile

Protocol: Saved sets server/device merge

How it syncs
readSavedSetsAsync: GET /api/v1/library/sets; pair each server set with a local copy by id, else by content (name + ordered track ids) for local ids (non-numeric); server fields win; unpaired local-id sets kept; numeric ids missing on server dropped (deleted elsewhere); write merged list to localStorage and remap draft id. writeSavedSetsAsync diffs against serverSetsCache: DELETE removed, PUT changed (updated or name differs), PUT /0 creates and expects {id}; pendingCreates map dedupes concurrent creates in-tab.
Conflicts
server wins on name, description, tracks; local-only fields (shape, minutes, mix, pool, seed) kept from local copy

GET failure -> device copy, source "device"

Gap: Saved-set shape is no longer shared between the two Set Builders

ml-gap-saved-set-shape · Critical · Built

musicLibrary sets carry tidal, shape, minutes, mix, pool, seed and ledger track ids (h:/bp:). songnodes stores only name, description and uuid track ids server-side and has no tidal flag. A songnodes 'Export sets for the weekly run' file imports into sets/set_tracks with uuid ids that match no ledger track, and sync-sets skips every set (no tidal). /api/v1/library/sets/export returns {sets:[...]} without ids, which load_sets turns into a list of lists and crashes on.

Fix
Version the document: add schema 'naarm.saved-set.v2' {id, name, shape, minutes, mix, pool, seed, tidal, tracks[{ml_id, sn_id, tgt, move}]}; songnodes stores the extra fields in library.sets (jsonb) and maps uuid->source_id via library.track_xref on export; load_sets accepts {sets:[...]} and resolves ids via xref.
Data contract
naarm.saved-set.v2
Affects
musicLibrary/pipeline/build_db.py, musicLibrary/pipeline/run_weekly.py, songnodes/frontend/src/features/musicLibrary/data.ts, songnodes/services/library/model/library_db.py

Gap: OAuth tokens written to sessionStorage have no reader

sn-fe-gap-oauth-session-tokens · High · Built

Settings connects in the same window (window.location.href), so OAuthCallback has no opener: it writes sessionStorage <service>_oauth_tokens and redirects to /. GraphPage and SettingsPanel only read localStorage tidal_oauth_tokens/spotify_oauth_tokens (which OAuthCallback removes), so the browser store never receives the tokens; sendToTidal and useTokenRefresh then lack an access token.

Fix
In OAuthCallback, when window.opener is null, call useStore.getState().credentials.updateCredentials(service,{accessToken,refreshToken,expiresAt,isConnected:true}) before redirecting to /settings/<service>-connection, and delete the sessionStorage write; or have SettingsPage read and clear sessionStorage '<service>_oauth_tokens' on mount.
Data contract
oauth-handoff/v1: {service, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at} consumed exactly once by the credentials slice

Backbone: Unified storage backbone

Keep each project's own data folder and owner. Add one shared contracts folder and one exchange folder with versioned, schema-checked files, so every cross-project hop is a named file or endpoint with one writer.

songnodes/
  contracts/                      # single source of every cross-project schema (exists; extend)
    library.set.saved.v2.json      # new
    library_ingest.openapi.yaml    # exists
    transitions.v1.json            # new
    setlists.v1.json               # new
  Postgres (compose volume)       # owner: songnodes services only
    bronze_* -> silver_* -> (gold_* decided in DFA gap) -> projection_*
musicLibrary/
  ledger/                         # owner: process step (append-only)
  db/dj_library.sqlite            # rebuilt each run from ledger
  inbox/                          # inputs written by people or other systems
  outputs/<date>/                 # run outputs, read by people
  exchange/                       # NEW: the only files the other project reads or writes
    library.json                  # musicLibrary -> songnodes (also POST /api/v1/library/ingest)
    saved-sets.json               # both ways, saved-set/2
    transitions.json              # songnodes -> musicLibrary, transitions/1
    setlists/*.json               # tracklists for songnodes import (moved from the root)
4 rows

Section 12: Methods, assumptions and open decisions

Profile: Project profile as applied

Scope
songnodes (E:\songnodes = github zvirb/songnodes main) and musicLibrary (E:\musicLibrary). Sub-projects scanned: songnodes frontend, services, scrapers, design-system; musicLibrary pipeline, artifact, ref_mb, plan.
Page source of truth
songnodes source tree on main @7429821 (no built bundle is kept in the repo); musicLibrary artifact/build/index.html is the live page, artifact/index.html is the legacy page (agent ml, M3 render).
Queued work
Open PRs #576–#580 (Duo 2FA, Cloudflare tunnel, login page, Sentinel sanitisation); musicLibrary plan/jules_payloads (30) and the unmerged WP7 brief.
Baseline report
PR #581 (ARCH1, opened 7 Nov 2026 09:23 by a parallel run on branch docs/data-flow-investigation): its numbers and gate claims are re-verified in the register (area baseline-581) and every topic it covers is kept; this report is merged into that branch. The register also re-checks the repos' own documentation.
Standing rules
R1–R8 from songnodes CLAUDE.md §2–§4 and AGENTS.md rule 12 (listed in section 3).
Retired or excluded
deploy/ and k8s/ (kept but unused, CLAUDE.md §1); musicLibrary _to_delete/ and data/ (data/ listed only).
Locale
en-AU, A4, Australia/Melbourne 24-hour time (design system 01-writing).
Personas
Inferred from pages and docs; merged across the three scans into one set (section 6).
Design system
SongNodes design system, artifact 7f37707d and repo mirror songnodes/design-system, 1.9.1 raised to 1.10.0 by this investigation.

Pre-flight: Tools and access

songnodes git
main @7429821, clean except untracked docs/DEPLOYMENT_E2E_STATUS_2026_11_06.md on the laptop; push via the session's GitHub app (REST only, GraphQL blocked)
musicLibrary git
Not a git repository: files only, no commits or PRs possible
Tools
node 22.23, python 3.13, graphviz dot 2.43, Chromium 153 (Playwright), poppler 24.02 (pdftoppm, pdffonts, pdftotext), pypdf 6.17; missing: PyMuPDF (not needed)
Laptop shell
tuf-boi Linux VM over the bridge: deletes blocked, no gh; used for the musicLibrary snapshot only
Existing reports
None of this kind. Related: songnodes docs/DATA_LAYER.md, STATUS.md, plan/RESTRUCTURE.md; musicLibrary README.md, docs/mb/*

Methods: Where the methods agreed and disagreed

37 notes
37 rows
Method notes. Column headers with buttons are sortable.
artifact localStorage keysM1, M3AgreeM1 found sn-music-library-sets, sn-set-draft, sn-filters-library, sn-banner-keyed-*; M3 also saw sn-density (written by SN.prefs, not in feature code). Legacy nsb:* keys found by M1 only, since the legacy page never reaches the draft write without library.json.
window.claude callsM1, M3AgreeBuild: use('db') then collection('sets').get; legacy: use('db'), use('user'), user.can('data.write'), onSnapshot('sets'). Without a stub no calls and no errors.
library.json beside the legacy pageM1, M3DisagreeCode fetches library.json relative to artifact/index.html (M1); file does not exist there, M3 got 404/CORS and 'Library file missing'. Confirms superseded status.
file:// renderM3AgreeBoth pages fail to load library.json from file:// (CORS, origin null); console errors only from that. Over http the build page renders 413 tracks with 0 console errors (stubbed claude) or one favicon 404.
songnodes sync contractM1, M2DisagreeREADME names scripts/sync-music-library.sh and frontend/public/data/music-library.json; neither exists. Code (M2: run_weekly.cmd_db -> cmd_sync_songnodes; songnodes import-music-library.sh) uses POST /api/v1/library/ingest.
artifact page sourceM1, M2DisagreeREADME says artifact/index.html is the page source; weekly_run.md and app/README say the published page is artifact/build/index.html built from songnodes pages.
BPM and key coverageM1, M3DisagreeCode and README describe a BPM-band method and Camelot moves; data (ledger, resolved files, SQLite) and the rendered page show 0 of 413 tracks with BPM or key.
sync-sets tidal_id fallbackM1Disagreesync-sets falls back to tr.tidal_id, but both page versions save tr.tidal (a URL), so the fallback never fires.
SQLite schemaM1, M3AgreeSCHEMA string matches sqlite_master of db/dj_library.sqlite (13 tables, 4 views); counts recorded from the file.
ref_mb consumersM1, M2AgreeOnly songnodes (refmb/settings.py, MB_LOCAL_* in compose.dev.yaml) reads ref_mb; no musicLibrary pipeline module does.
HTTP endpointsM1, M2, M3AgreeAST parse found 215 decorated routes (rest-api 98 incl. main.py, graph-api 18, unified-scraper 5, audio-analysis 4, rest are non-compose services). Registry check: every rest-api router with routes is mounted explicitly or via register(); data_quality is neither (its decorators are commented out, AST found none).
rest-api /api/graph/nodes and /edgesM2, M3DisagreeAST lists them on rest-api; nginx config routes ^/api/graph to graph-api, so they are unreachable from the frontend.
Silver writersM1, M2DisagreeDocs say silver comes from bronze ETL only; grep finds the scraper persistence pipeline, rest-api catalog writes, and one-off scripts also writing silver_enriched_tracks.
Gold layerM1, M2Disagreegrep finds gold ETL code and Helm cronjobs; compose/start-dev never run or migrate them; gold_track_graph has zero readers.
RabbitMQ usageM1, M2Disagreegrep finds aio_pika in audio-analysis, metadata-enrichment, dlq-manager, websocket-api and a scraper publisher; compose gives RabbitMQ only to worker (Celery) and scraper env; audio-analysis has no RabbitMQ env so its consumer stays off.
Redis graph cacheM1Disagreecache_result decorator and CACHE_TTL exist, but no route uses the decorator; only batch:{id} keys are written.
Frontend-to-backend routesM1, M3DisagreeFrontend references /api/v1/scrapers/target-tracks/search and /api/v1/scrapers/queue/clear; AST route list has neither.
MemgraphM1, M2Disagreegraph_projection code and job kinds exist; compose has no memgraph service or MEMGRAPH_* env.
Migrations appliedM2Agreecompose initdb mounts (001,002,006,012,013,014) and start-dev.sh psql lines (101,170,180-185,220,240,260,270,280, init/07) cross-checked with worker/migrate.py REQUIRED list.
Open PRs #576-#580M1, M2AgreeRead via gh REST pulls/{n}/files and patches; items marked state queued. #578 adds no route-gating middleware; #577 adds public ingress.
R6 router registrationM2, M3DisagreeAST check for top-level register() (router_registry._defines_register) vs main.py include_router list: 11 routers lack register() and rely on explicit wiring.
routesM1, M2DisagreeGrep finds PlannedModulePage for /paths in STATIC_ROUTES; registry replacement logic (M2) shows features/pathfinder/route.tsx overrides it, so the planned page is dead.
LiveDataLoader /api/wsM1, M2DisagreeGrep finds a WebSocket client; import graph from main.tsx shows LiveDataLoader and useLiveDataLoader are never imported.
services/api.ts clientsM1, M2DisagreeGrep lists ~20 endpoints; only api.get/post/put/delete (target-tracks client) and trackApi (from unreachable NowPlayingDeck) are imported; backend route scan shows most paths do not exist.
songnodes_ai_prompt_historyM1, M2DisagreeKey found by grep; its only consumer AIAssistantModal is unreachable.
OAuth token storageM1, M2DisagreeWriters use sessionStorage <service>_oauth_tokens; readers use localStorage tidal_oauth_tokens; same-window redirect means no postMessage path.
display preference keysM1, M3Agreebundle.js and index.html both use sn-theme/sn-text-size/sn-density/sn-motion; Playwright render of reference.html wrote sn-density only.
design-system previewsM1, M3DisagreeGrep shows previews write sn-disclosure:* and sn-skip-moved-targets; Playwright standalone render throws before writing because window.SongNodes is injected by the card host.
nginx proxy targetM2Agreecompose.dev.yaml builds frontend/Dockerfile whose inline default.conf is the only live proxy; nginx/ and nginx-local-proxy.conf are not referenced by compose (only Helm values mount a default.conf).
frontend endpoints vs backendM1, M2DisagreeStatic route scan of services/rest_api and graph-visualization-api (120 decorators) found no match for /api/v1/scrapers/*, /api/v1/search/*, /api/v1/pathfinding/*, /api/graph/tracks|positions, /api/ws; prefixes defined via include_router in main.py were not resolved, so a few may exist (see unverified).
public/data/music-library.jsonM1, M2DisagreePlan briefs (DB1, L8, QA7) describe the static file and its fallback; the file is absent from frontend/public and no code fetches /data/*.json. Only tests/e2e/data/library.fixture.json remains (test-only).
R2/R5 conformanceM1, repo checkerDisagreecheck_design_system.py --check and design-system/linters/check.py report 0 findings on all route page files, but grep finds two simultaneous primaries (Set builder, Pathfinder), Title Case labels and "Unknown" fallbacks.

Decisions: Assumptions and open decisions

  • The laptop copy of songnodes equals origin/main @7429821 (git status showed only one untracked doc).
  • musicLibrary data/ (58 GB) holds raw dumps and caches; it was listed, not read.
  • Effort sizes (S, M, L) are Estimates from evidence spread against the AGENTS.md package budget.
  • Gap severity is the highest severity of debt sharing evidence with the gap, otherwise medium (Estimate).
  • Open decision: keep a gold layer or document silver-plus-projection as the model (SN-T06).
  • Open decision: which Set Builder is primary once both read the same saved-set shape.
